result.topic_en: Calculations with modules (rational number classes) a, b, c and derived modules a''', b''', c''', a_1, b_1, c_1, showing identities such as b + c_1 = b'' and a - b'' = a_1, then determining representatives α_1, β_1 modulo c_3 = a - b when c is one-membered (eingliedrig).
result.transcription:
$\mathfrak{a}''' = \mathfrak{b}+\mathfrak{c}\ ,\ \mathfrak{b}''' = \mathfrak{c}+\mathfrak{a}\ ,\ \mathfrak{c}''' = \mathfrak{a}+\mathfrak{b}$
$\mathfrak{a}_1 = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{a}''',\ \mathfrak{b}_1 = \mathfrak{b}-\mathfrak{b}''',\ \mathfrak{c}_1 = \mathfrak{c}-\mathfrak{c}'''$
$\mathfrak{b}+\mathfrak{c}_1 = \mathfrak{b}+(\mathfrak{c}-\mathfrak{c}''') = (\mathfrak{b}+\mathfrak{c})-\mathfrak{c}''' = \mathfrak{a}'''-\mathfrak{c}''' = \mathfrak{b}''$
$\mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{b}'' = \mathfrak{a}-(\mathfrak{a}'''-\mathfrak{c}''') = (\mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{c}''')-\mathfrak{a}''' = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{a}''' = \mathfrak{a}_1$
$\mathfrak{b}'' = \mathfrak{a}'''-\mathfrak{c}''' = \mathfrak{b}+\mathfrak{c}_1 = \mathfrak{b}+\mathfrak{a}_1$
$\mathfrak{a}_1 = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{a}''' = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{b}'' = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{c}'' = \mathfrak{a}-(\mathfrak{b}''-\mathfrak{c}'') = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{d}'$
$\mathfrak{c}$ eingliedrig, also auch $\mathfrak{c}_1 = \mathfrak{c}-\mathfrak{c}'''$
$\mathfrak{c}_1 = [\gamma_1]\ ;\ \gamma_1 = \alpha_1+\beta_1 = \alpha_1'+\beta_1'$
$\alpha_1-\alpha_1' = \beta_1'-\beta_1 \equiv 0$ (mod. $\mathfrak{a}_1-\mathfrak{b}_1 = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{b} = \mathfrak{c}_3$)
Also
$\alpha_1\ ,\ \beta_1$ bestimmt mod. $\mathfrak{c}_3 = \mathfrak{a}-\mathfrak{b}$
$\mathfrak{n} = [\alpha_1+\gamma_3]$, wo $\gamma_3$ willkürlich $\equiv 0$ (mod. $\mathfrak{c}_3$)
$\alpha_1 \equiv \gamma_1$ (mod. $\mathfrak{b}_1$), $\alpha_1 \equiv 0$ (mod. $\mathfrak{a}_1$)
oder auch nur
$\alpha_1 \equiv \gamma_1$ (mod. $\mathfrak{b}$), $\alpha_1 \equiv 0$ (mod. $\mathfrak{a}$)

methods.what: Definition of derived modules as sums of the other two and differences (intersections) with them
Identity b + c_1 = b'' via modular law
Chain of equalities for a_1 in terms of d'
Decomposition of generator γ_1 of one-membered c_1 is unique modulo c_3 = a - b
